Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for SaaS multi-tenant application'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment name
  
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: saasdb
    Description: Name of the database
  
  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    Description: Master username for the database
  
  MasterUserPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Master password for the database
  
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID for the Aurora cluster
  
  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Subnet IDs for the Aurora cluster

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    development:
      MinCapacity: 0.5
      MaxCapacity: 2
    staging:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 4
    production:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 8

Resources:
  AuroraSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AuroraAccessSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-sg"
  
  AuroraAccessSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for applications accessing Aurora
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-access-sg"
  
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Aurora cluster
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-subnet-group"
  
  AuroraClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Parameter group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      Family: aurora-postgresql14
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: '1'
        shared_preload_libraries: auto_explain,pg_stat_statements,pg_hint_plan,pg_telemetry
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  
  AuroraDBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '14.7'
      EngineMode: provisioned
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, MinCapacity]
        MaxCapacity: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, MaxCapacity]
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref MasterUserPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref AuroraSecurityGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref AuroraClusterParameterGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: true
      StorageEncrypted: true
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: true
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Port: 5432
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-cluster"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  
  AuroraPrimaryInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '14.7'
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref AuroraDBCluster
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-primary"
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      EnablePerformanceInsights: true
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: 7
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-primary"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  
  AuroraReaderInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Condition: IsNotDevelopment
    Properties:
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '14.7'
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref AuroraDBCluster
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-reader"
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      EnablePerformanceInsights: true
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: 7
      MonitoringInterval: 60
      MonitoringRoleArn: !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-reader"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  
  RDSMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: monitoring.rds.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonRDSEnhancedMonitoringRole
      Path: /
  
  Secret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: Aurora PostgreSQL credentials
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"username": "${MasterUsername}"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-secret"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  AuroraClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Aurora cluster endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraDBCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraClusterEndpoint"
  
  AuroraReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Aurora reader endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraDBCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraReaderEndpoint"
  
  AuroraClusterPort:
    Description: Aurora cluster port
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraDBCluster.Endpoint.Port
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraClusterPort"
  
  AuroraSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Aurora security group ID
    Value: !Ref AuroraSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraSecurityGroupId"
  
  AuroraAccessSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Aurora access security group ID
    Value: !Ref AuroraAccessSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraAccessSecurityGroupId"
  
  SecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret ARN
    Value: !Ref Secret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SecretArn"

Conditions:
  IsNotDevelopment: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentName, development]]
